about: The great houses' trades (Docs/Design/61-industry-of-the-realm.md). A house is found by its head's work label ("ruling House Fell", "keeping Grayrock Hall"); this says which is which, by a word of its name (names), and what it owns in its city: a business whose keeper's label or workplace carries one of its names (the Grayrock Foundry), else one whose kind (businesses.json) is among its businesses. Any other business is its keeper's own. A house a world has no entry for owns as before (industry, and half the shops, by lot). Change it and a save's businesses are given out again, once.
